title: Build a Meta Ads Campaign from Scratch
description: In this lab, you will build a complete Meta (Facebook/Instagram) advertising campaign from scratch — from Business Manager setup to creating ad sets with different audiences, designing creatives, and submitting the campaign for review. You will work with a real (or simulated) ad account and learn the exact workflow used by professional media buyers.
prerequisites: Access to a Facebook Business Page (create one if you don't have one)
Canva account (free) for creating ad images
A landing page URL to drive traffic to (your website, Carrd page, or Google Form)
Budget: Minimum ₹500 if running a live campaign (optional — you can build everything without spending)

steps.title: Set Up Meta Business Manager & Ad Account
steps.instructions: Go to business.facebook.com. If you haven't set up Business Manager before, click 'Create Account'. Enter: Business Name (e.g., 'TechPath Academy' or your own brand name), Your Name, Business Email. Click Submit. Once inside Business Manager, set up your Ad Account: Go to Business Settings (gear icon, bottom left) > Accounts > Ad Accounts. Click 'Add' > 'Create a New Ad Account'. Name: 'TechPath Ads' (or your brand). Time Zone: India Standard Time (IST). Currency: Indian Rupee (INR). Click Create. Now add your payment method: Go to Billing (Business Settings > Payments). Click 'Add Payment Method'. Options: Debit card, Credit card, or Paytm UPI (Meta accepts Indian payment methods). If you're NOT spending real money (simulation only), you can skip payment but won't be able to publish the campaign. Next, connect your Page: Business Settings > Accounts > Pages > Add > select your Facebook Page. Finally, connect your Instagram account: Business Settings > Accounts > Instagram Accounts > Add > log into Instagram. Verify everything is set up by checking: (1) Ad Account shows status 'Active', (2) Facebook Page is connected, (3) Instagram account is linked. Take a screenshot of your Business Settings showing all connected assets.

steps.title: Create Campaign with Traffic Objective
steps.instructions: Go to Ads Manager (adsmanager.facebook.com). Click '+ Create' (green button). You will see campaign objectives organized in 6 categories. Select 'Traffic' (under Consideration). Why Traffic? It optimizes for people most likely to click your link and visit your landing page — perfect for driving website visits when you don't have pixel data for conversion optimization yet. Campaign Name: 'TechPath DM Course - Traffic - July 2026'. Campaign Special Ad Categories: Select 'None' (education ads don't require special category in India unless targeting by age/gender for specific restricted topics). Budget: Choose 'Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO)' — this lets Meta automatically distribute budget across your ad sets to the best performers. Set Daily Budget: ₹500 per day (or your chosen amount). If simulating, you can set any amount. Bid Strategy: Keep 'Lowest Cost' (default) — Meta will try to get you the most link clicks at the lowest cost. A/B Test: Skip for now (we'll test by creating multiple ad sets manually). Click 'Next' to proceed to Ad Set level. IMPORTANT: Do NOT click 'Publish' yet — we need to build the full campaign structure first.

steps.title: Build 3 Ad Sets with Different Audiences
steps.instructions: You are now at the Ad Set level. Create 3 ad sets to test different audience strategies. AD SET 1 — Interest-Based (Cold Audience): Name: 'Interest - Career Seekers 20-28 Bhopal'. Conversion Location: Website. Optimization: Landing Page Views (not just link clicks — this targets people who actually wait for the page to load). Budget: If not using CBO, set ₹200/day for this ad set. Schedule: Start today, no end date (we'll monitor and pause manually). Audience: Location = Bhopal + 25km radius (or your city). Age = 20-28. Gender = All. Detailed Targeting: Type and select these interests: 'Digital marketing', 'Online advertising', 'Career development', 'Entrepreneurship', 'Social media marketing'. Also add behaviors: 'Engaged shoppers'. Audience size should show 'Specific' to 'Broad' range (ideal: 200,000-1,000,000 people). Placements: Select 'Advantage+ Placements' (let Meta optimize across Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels automatically). Save this Ad Set. AD SET 2 — Lookalike Audience (Scale): Duplicate Ad Set 1 (click the three dots > Duplicate). Rename: 'Lookalike - Similar to Website Visitors'. Change audience: Remove all detailed targeting. Under Custom Audiences, click 'Create New' > Lookalike Audience. Source: If you have a Custom Audience (website visitors or customer list), select it. If not, select your Facebook Page followers. Location: India (or your state). Lookalike size: 1% (most similar to your source). Keep age 20-30, all genders. Save. AD SET 3 — Retargeting (Warm Audience): Duplicate Ad Set 1 again. Rename: 'Retargeting - Page Engagers 30 Days'. Change audience: Remove detailed targeting. Under Custom Audiences > Create New > Custom Audience > Facebook Page. Select your page. Engagement type: 'Everyone who engaged with your Page'. Time period: Last 30 days. Also add (if available): Instagram business profile engagers (last 30 days). Exclude: Anyone who already converted (if you have a thank-you page custom audience). Reduce location targeting to All India (retargeting audiences are already qualified). Budget: If not using CBO, set ₹100/day (retargeting needs less budget, smaller audience). Save. Review: You should now have 3 Ad Sets visible in your campaign — each targeting a different audience segment.

steps.title: Design Ad Creatives (1 Static Image + 1 Carousel)
steps.instructions: Now create the ads within each Ad Set. We'll create 2 creatives and use them across all 3 ad sets (you can customize copy per ad set later). CREATIVE 1 — Static Image Ad: First, design the image in Canva. Go to canva.com > Create Design > search 'Facebook Ad' (1200x628) or 'Instagram Post' (1080x1080). Use 1080x1080 (square) as it works on both Facebook and Instagram. Design an ad with: Bold headline text on image (e.g., 'Become a Digital Marketer in 6 Months'), A relevant image (classroom, laptop, or people working), Your brand name/logo, A contrasting CTA button graphic (e.g., 'Register Now'). Rule: Keep text under 20% of image area (Meta penalizes text-heavy images). Download as PNG. Now in Ads Manager: Inside Ad Set 1, click 'New Ad'. Ad Name: 'Static - Career Transformation'. Format: Single Image. Upload your Canva image. Primary Text (125 chars visible): 'Tired of applying to jobs with no response? Learn Digital Marketing in 6 months and land a ₹4-8 LPA job. 500+ already placed.' Headline: 'Digital Marketing Course Bhopal' (40 chars). Description: '6 Months | Live Projects | EMI Available' (30 chars). CTA Button: 'Learn More'. Website URL: Your landing page + UTM parameters (e.g., yoursite.com/course?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=dm_course&utm_content=static_career). CREATIVE 2 — Carousel Ad: In the same Ad Set, create another ad. Ad Name: 'Carousel - Course Highlights'. Format: Carousel. Create 4-5 cards in Canva (1080x1080 each): Card 1: 'Learn SEO & Rank #1 on Google', Card 2: 'Master Facebook & Google Ads', Card 3: 'AI Tools for Marketing', Card 4: '100% Placement Assistance', Card 5: '₹45,000 (EMI from ₹7,500/month)'. Upload each card image. Add headline for each card (max 40 chars). Primary Text: 'Everything you need to launch a career in Digital Marketing — from SEO to AI. Join 500+ students who landed jobs at top companies.' CTA: 'Sign Up'. Website URL: Same landing page with utm_content=carousel_highlights. After creating both ads in Ad Set 1, duplicate them to Ad Set 2 and Ad Set 3 (click three dots on each ad > Duplicate to another Ad Set). You now have 2 ads in each of 3 ad sets = 6 ads total.

steps.title: Set Budget, Schedule, and Submit for Review
steps.instructions: Final review before submission. Go to the campaign overview level and verify everything: CAMPAIGN LEVEL: Check — Objective is Traffic, CBO is ON, Daily budget is ₹500 (or your amount), Bid strategy is Lowest Cost. AD SET LEVEL: Check each of the 3 ad sets: (1) Interest-based — audience size between 200K-1M, location correct, age correct, placements set to Advantage+. (2) Lookalike — source audience connected, 1% lookalike, location correct. (3) Retargeting — custom audience selected, exclusions set, smaller audience size is normal (10K-100K). AD LEVEL: Check each ad: (1) Images uploaded and displaying correctly (no cropping issues), (2) Primary text is compelling and under 125 chars visible, (3) Headlines are clear and under 40 chars, (4) URLs are correct with UTM parameters, (5) CTA buttons selected, (6) Preview all ads in different placements — click 'Preview' to see how ads look in Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, Stories, and Reels. SCHEDULING: If running a live campaign: Set start date to today, no end date (you'll pause manually after testing). If simulating: Set a future start date (you can pause before it starts). FINAL CHECKS before publishing: (1) Open your landing page URL — does it load fast? Is it mobile-friendly? (2) Click each UTM link — does it resolve to the right page? (3) Is conversion tracking active? (Meta Pixel installed and working). SUBMIT: Click 'Publish' (bottom right). Your campaign enters Meta's ad review process (usually takes 5-60 minutes). Status will show 'In Review' then change to 'Active' or 'Rejected'. If rejected: Read the rejection reason in Ads Manager notifications, fix the issue (usually policy violation like too much text on image, misleading claims, or landing page issues), and resubmit. Take screenshots of: (1) Full campaign structure view showing campaign > 3 ad sets > 6 ads, (2) One ad preview in Facebook Feed format, (3) One ad preview in Instagram Stories format, (4) Campaign status after review (Active or In Review).

deliverables: Business Manager setup with Ad Account, Page, and Instagram connected
Complete campaign structure: 1 Campaign > 3 Ad Sets > 6 Ads
Ad creative images (designed in Canva) — 1 static + 1 carousel set
Screenshots of campaign structure and ad previews
Campaign submitted for review (or saved as draft if not spending)
assessment_criteria: Business Manager correctly configured with all assets connected
Campaign objective and budget strategy appropriate for goal
Three ad sets target genuinely different audience segments with logical reasoning
Ad creatives are professional, follow Meta ad specs, and have under 20% text
All ads have proper copy (within character limits), UTM tracking, and correct CTA
